title: 'Tried to do as much research as we can on him': Tucker stunned by Sooryavanshi hype
summary: Ireland captain Lorcan Tucker expressed awe at 15-year-old Indian batting prodigy Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's rapid rise, calling it "pretty incredible" for the modern era. Tucker highlighted the excitement Sooryavanshi generates, especially among Ireland's Indian community, and acknowledged his potential as a global role model.
